text:
Situation: Sertraline hydrochloride 25 mg tablets (NDC 68788404503, labeler Preferred Pharmaceuticals Inc.) are not on FDA's drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21. Corvale Lakeside holds 15 tablets at a use rate of 1.8 per day, providing 8.5 days on hand, which is below the two‑week buffer. Corvale East holds 208 tablets (31.1 days) and Corvale General holds 224 tablets (28.4 days).

Why (FDA record): FDA's most recent inspection of the Preferred Pharmaceuticals Inc. repack plant (FEI 3004582966) ended 2025-05-27 and was classified VAI, with the classification known on 2025-07-30. The drug is not listed on FDA's shortage list.

Our position: No national shortage exists. The issue is a local imbalance at Corvale Lakeside. Internal transfer can resolve the shortfall without new purchasing.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 10 tablets of 25 mg from Corvale East to Corvale Lakeside — needs pharmacy director approval of the transfer request.
2. Transfer 10 tablets of 25 mg from Corvale General to Corvale Lakeside — needs pharmacy director approval of the transfer request.

Not recommended: Purchasing from Accord Healthcare Inc., Advanced Rx Pharmacy of Tennessee LLC, or Ascent Pharmaceuticals Inc. at this time; their labels do not identify a plant we can verify and no shortage justifies new procurement.
